newsitem.title: FINLAND: STARCKJOHANN REPEATS SEES IMPROVING PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: STARCKJOHANN REPEATS SEES IMPROVING PROFIT.

text.p: Finnish hardware wholesaler and retailer Starckjohann Oy said on Wednesday it expected profitability and profits to improve this year.

"The investments implemented and underway will increase profitability and so the group's earnings are expected to improve," Starckjohann said in a statement with its 1996 results. "The cyclical outlook is better than in 1996 on all of the Starckjohann group's main markets," it said.

Last year, Starckjohann's profit after financial items eased 1.7 percent to 77.4 million markka, but earnings per share edged slightly higher, to 0.62 markka from 0.58 markka. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
